'''Armed conflicts and attacks'''
*[[Russo-Ukrainian War]]
**[[Russian invasion of Ukraine]]
***[[Crisis at the Zaporizhzhia Nuclear Power Plant]]
****[[Ukraine]] accuses [[Russia]] of [[kidnapping]] two senior employees of the [[Zaporizhzhia Nuclear Power Plant]]. [https://www.barrons.com/articles/ukraine-says-russia-kidnapped-two-nuclear-plant-workers-01666073707 (Agence France Presse via ''Barron's'')]
***Three people are killed and critical infrastructure is destroyed by [[Russia]]n missiles in [[Kyiv]], causing fires, [[explosion]]s, and [[power outage]]s. Several other cities across [[Ukraine]] are also hit in targeted attacks against water supplies and energy facilities, with [[power outage]]s being reported in 1,162 towns and villages. [https://www.reuters.com/world/europe/russia-attacks-energy-facility-northern-kyiv-presidential-aide-2022-10-18/ (Reuters)] [https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-europe-63297239 (BBC News)]
***[[Iran]] agrees to provide Russia with medium-range [[missile]]s, [[surface-to-surface missile]]s and [[Unmanned combat aerial vehicle|combat drones]] for the war in Ukraine. [https://www.theguardian.com/world/2022/oct/18/iran-agrees-to-supply-missiles-as-well-as-drones-to-russia (''The Guardian'')]
*[[Insurgency in Jammu and Kashmir]]
**Two people are killed in a [[grenade]] attack in [[Shopian]], [[Jammu and Kashmir (union territory)|Jammu and Kashmir]], [[India]]. [https://www.reuters.com/world/india/militants-indian-kashmir-kill-two-migrant-workers-2022-10-18/ (Reuters)]
*Multiple people are killed and 10 others are abducted after gunmen storm a hospital in [[Niger State]], [[Nigeria]]. [https://www.reuters.com/world/africa/gunmen-abduct-least-10-hospital-workers-nigerias-niger-state-2022-10-18/ (Reuters)]

'''Disasters and accidents'''
*[[Hurricane Julia (2022)|Hurricane Julia]]
**The death toll from the October 8 [[landslide]] in [[Santos Michelena Municipality|Las Tejerías]], [[Venezuela]], increases to 54. [https://www.laprensalatina.com/hope-fading-10-days-into-search-for-missing-in-venezuela-landslide/ (La Prensa Latina)]
*Seven people are killed when a helicopter carrying [[pilgrim]]s crashes in [[Uttarakhand]], [[India]]. [https://mynorthwest.com/3676733/helicopter-carrying-hindu-pilgrims-crashes-in-northern-india/ (AP)]
*Two people are killed and three others are injured when a [[hot air balloon]] carrying [[tourism in Turkey|tourists]] crashes in [[Nevşehir]], [[Turkey]]. [https://apnews.com/article/travel-middle-east-turkey-accidents-11fd944ab86173365476a470f349aced (AP)]

'''Health and environment'''
*The [[United States Department of Agriculture|U.S. Department of Agriculture]] announces that more than 47 million [[chicken]]s and [[Turkey (bird)|turkey]]s have died this year of [[Influenza A virus subtype H5N1|H5N1]] [[Avian influenza|bird flu]] or related culling in the [[United States]], amid the deadliest outbreak of the disease in the country since 2015. [https://www.reuters.com/world/us/us-nears-record-poultry-deaths-bird-flu-virus-type-complicates-fight-2022-10-18/ (Reuters)]

'''International relations'''
*[[Status of Jerusalem]], [[Australia–Israel relations]]
**[[Australia]]n [[Minister for Foreign Affairs (Australia)|Foreign Minister]] [[Penny Wong]] confirms that Australia will no longer recognise [[West Jerusalem]] as the capital of [[Israel]] until [[Israeli–Palestinian peace process|peace negotiations]] are finalised. [https://www.theguardian.com/australia-news/2022/oct/18/penny-wong-denies-formal-change-on-australia-recognition-of-west-jerusalem-israel-capital (''The Guardian'')]
*[[Foreign relations of the United Kingdom]], [[Visa policy of the United Kingdom]]
**The [[United Kingdom]] announces [[travel visa|visa]]-free entry for ordinary citizens of [[Colombia]], [[Guyana]] and [[Peru]]. [https://www.elespectador.com/mundo/america/reino-unido-retira-su-requisito-de-visas-para-peru-desde-el-9-de-noviembre-noticias-hoy/ (''El Espectador'')] [https://demerarawaves.com/2022/10/18/breaking-guyanese-can-now-travel-to-the-uk-visa-free/ (Demerara Waves)]
*[[Chechen–Russian conflict]], [[Russia–Ukraine relations]]
**The [[Verkhovna Rada]] of [[Ukraine]] passes a resolution recognising [[Chechnya]] as "temporarily occupied" by [[Russia]], as well as condemning [[Russian war crimes#Chechnya|war crimes committed by Russia]] during the [[First Chechen War|First]] and [[Second Chechen War]]s. [https://www.reuters.com/world/europe/ukraine-lawmakers-brand-chechnya-russian-occupied-dig-kremlin-2022-10-18/ (Reuters)]

'''Law and crime'''
*[[Internet censorship in Russia]]
**A court in [[Moscow]] fines [[Amazon (company)|Amazon, Inc.]] four million [[Russian ruble|rubles]] (US$65,000) for failing to delete content on drug use and for "propagandizing [[suicide]]". [https://www.reuters.com/technology/russia-court-fines-amazon-1-million-roubles-failure-delete-illegal-content-2022-10-18/ (Reuters)]
*Two people are killed and another person is injured in a stabbing in [[Ludwigshafen]], [[Rhineland-Palatinate]], [[Germany]]. The suspect, a 25-year-old [[Somalis in Germany|Somali]] man, is shot and injured by police before being arrested. [https://apnews.com/article/germany-527f7d805d2c8cfbbe9bca770692dad6 (AP)]

'''Politics and elections'''
*[[2021–2022 inflation surge]]
**A nationwide strike begins in [[France]] with workers demanding higher salaries amid increasing [[inflation]] in the country. [https://www.euronews.com/next/2022/10/18/france-strike (Euronews)]
